name: Sparse Point Probability Octree
definition: A sparse octree structure storing a point probability $p_i$ for each leaf node, used to estimate point positions for radiance field rendering. It replaces explicit persistent point positions with a probabilistic volume representation that can be sampled on demand.
summary: A hierarchical data structure for radiance field rendering that replaces fixed point positions with a probabilistic volume, dynamically updating nodes based on rendering feedback rather than static geometry.
